description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Tri-Element Mode II (Fire, Ice, Holy)], [Awoken Mastery], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Wild Rose Axiom] to the user

description.name: Awoken Mastery
description.text: Holy, Ice and Fire abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Holy, Ice and Fire abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Weapon Waltz after using Holy, Ice or Fire abilities

description.name: Weapon Waltz
description.text: 4/6/8 single attacks (0.70 each) if the user's HP is greater than or equal to 0/34/67%, 100% hit rate

description.name: Tri-Element Mode II (Fire, Ice, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Holy with Stacking] after using a Fire/Ice/Holy ability

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Wild Rose Axiom
description.text: Grants [100% Critical 1] and [PHY +30% Boost 1] after using two Fire, Ice or Holy abilities
